initialUserIntent: Complete the Java navigation part of JetBrains-style IDE management: go-to-definition and references for Java, wired into the editor. The IDE already has navigation infrastructure (useRefactorKitSymbolNavigationController wired in App.tsx, documentNavigation.navigateToLocation as reveal driver, editor revealRequest) but it is TypeScript/JavaScript saved-snapshot focused; Java go-to-definition/references via the RefactorKit engine (real_engine.rs definition/references commands) or Java language service is not wired for Java. This slice makes Java navigation operational: resolve a Java symbol definition and references, present them, and navigate/reveal on selection, with honest-unavailable when the capability is absent.

approvedChanges.statement: Pi is, in the future, ONE of the usable agents in the IDE, not the sole AI/model authority.
User authorized RefactorKit as a PRODUCT FEATURE. Java TEST infra (JavaSpec/Maven/JUnit/dataset) and Java-only RefactorKit rules as workflow refactoring authority remain EXCLUDED.

requirement.title: Java go-to-definition and references wired in the IDE editor
requirement.classification: Story BDD + Spec BDD for pure view-model decisions
requirement.capability: Resolve a Java symbol definition (go-to-definition) and its references (find-references) via the RefactorKit engine (real_engine.rs definition/references commands) or the Java language service, present results, and navigate/reveal the selected location in the editor. Honest-unavailable when the capability is absent or the symbol is unresolvable. Reuses the existing navigation infrastructure (useRefactorKitSymbolNavigationController + documentNavigation.navigateToLocation + editor revealRequest).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given a Java symbol FQN, the IDE resolves its definition (go-to-definition) via the RefactorKit engine/java-language capability and reveals the location in the editor.
Given a Java symbol FQN, the IDE resolves its references (find-references) and presents them; selecting a reference navigates/reveals that location.
The flow follows extract -> delegate -> response with no hidden domain policy; absent capability or unresolvable symbol reports honest unavailable/error, never fabricated result.
Boundary invariant: packages/ui, packages/web-core, apps/web never import @tauri-apps/api; browser/Tauri Java navigation implementations live behind frontend ports.
Status is evidence-based with an explicit state, never inferred from shells; live Tauri-window navigation E2E may remain unvalidated if headless (recorded honestly).

requirement.owner: bdd-ts-domain-expert (domain research) + bdd-ts-gherkin-writer (feature) + ts-story-driven (Story) + tauri-rust-coder (engine definition/references) + tauri-adapter-coder + browser-adapter-coder + frontend-core-coder/frontend-app-coder (view-model + controller wiring)
requirement.scope: Java go-to-definition + references wired in the editor, reusing existing navigation infrastructure. The existing TS saved-snapshot navigation stays as-is (no rework). Java build/run/debug and project model remain separate later slices.
exclusions: JavaSpec, Maven, JUnit-specific policy, Java datasets as workflow test infra
Java-only RefactorKit rules as the workflow's own refactoring authority
openQuestions: Source: whether Java definition/references come from the RefactorKit engine (real_engine.rs definition/references) or the Java language service (java_language.rs) — confirm the primary source.
Editor wiring: whether Java navigation is proven wired into the live editor or a desktop-harness renderer is acceptable evidence.
Reuse: whether to extend the existing useRefactorKitSymbolNavigationController or add a Java-specific controller.
Reveal: confirm navigation uses documentNavigation.navigateToLocation + editor revealRequest (existing driver).
